verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agent-facing product search and affiliate commerce API, so tracking orders after purchase is a fair question for it. The evidence documents product search, product lookup, affiliate sale recording and price-tracking webhooks, but no endpoint or tool for an agent to query an order's status or shipment tracking. Price-change webhooks and affiliate sale attribution are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can query the status and tracking of an order it placed, after the purchase
